title: A held account on the Accounts page shows the provider's sentence and back time, not raw JSON
description: Seeds an account held from the 2026-11-21 Claude probe JSON fixture, opens Settings › Agents (the Accounts page) in a browser, and asserts the held row shows 'weekly limit' and 'back <day> at <time>' with no '{' or '"api_error'.

steps.name: Accounts page renders held account sentence and reset day without raw JSON
